relations.evidence: Taught Pāli as a Docent at Taisho University in Tokyo from 1921

relations.subject: Anton Walter Florus Gueth
relations.evidence: and at Kamazawa University from 1922, from 1925 as a Professor. In 1926 he was finally allowed by British to return to Sri Lanka

relations.evidence: Among his disciples were Vappa (L. Stolz), Sumana (Fr. Stange), Nyānaponika (—> S. Feniger)

relations.subject: Nyānasatta
relations.evidence: Among his disciples were Vappa (L. Stolz), Sumana (Fr. Stange), Nyānaponika (—> S. Feniger) and Nyānasatta (—> M. Novosad).
